args.query: Monthly Treasury Statement receipts outlays deficit

sql: SELECT record_fiscal_year AS fy, classification_desc, line_code_nbr, current_month_rcpt_outly_amt/1e9 AS bn FROM econ.mts_outlays_by_function WHERE record_date IN ('2026-10-31','2025-10-31','2024-10-31') ORDER BY CAST(line_code_nbr AS INTEGER), record_fiscal_year

args.query: debt held by the public total public debt outstanding

sql: SELECT record_date, debt_held_public_amt/1e12 AS dhp FROM econ.federal_debt WHERE record_date IN ('2026-10-31','2025-10-31','2019-10-31','2024-10-31') ORDER BY record_date
SELECT record_date, current_month_rcpt_outly_amt/1e9 AS bn FROM econ.mts_outlays_by_function WHERE line_code_nbr='100' AND record_date>='2026-01-31' ORDER BY record_date
SELECT record_date, debt_held_public_amt/1e12 AS dhp FROM econ.federal_debt WHERE record_date>='2026-10-20' ORDER BY record_date DESC
SELECT record_date, debt_held_public_amt/1e12 AS dhp FROM econ.federal_debt WHERE record_date IN ('2026-10-30','2026-10-29','2025-10-31','2025-10-30','2019-10-31','2019-10-30') ORDER BY record_date
